title: Research Reporting & Publication Command Centre
based_on: AGROLATTICE 11.14 — Model Evidence Command Centre & Scientific Validation
database_migration: No protected scientific database schema changes. A new additive reports/reporting.sqlite schema 1.0.0 is introduced; legacy study_store JSON remains intact and can be imported explicitly.
headline_features: Persistent Reporting & Publication Command Centre with lazy navigation.
Field/Experiment/Twin/Model-aware report scope and report-readiness checks.
Immutable report versions and frozen evidence snapshots with SHA-256.
Publication table/figure registry with provenance and multi-panel figures.
Citation library and method implementation-relationship tracking.
Internal/public reproducibility packages with transparent redaction manifest.
Improved structured abstract, manuscript metadata, word counts and DOCX/Markdown/HTML export.
Legacy Release-3 JSON studies remain importable without deletion.
limitations: Full interactive browser verification requires the target Streamlit environment.
Automated redaction does not guarantee complete de-identification of arbitrary free text.
Automated report auditing is advisory and does not replace scientific/statistical review.
Journal-specific current formatting rules are not assumed without explicit verification.
